newsitem.title: ECUADOR: SOCCER-ECUADOR'S BUCARAM TAKES OVER SOCCER CLUB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ECUADOR'S BUCARAM TAKES OVER SOCCER CLUB.

text.p: Ecuador's flamboyant President Abdala Bucaram fulfilled another burning ambition this week when he became leader of the popular local soccer club Barcelona.

"Life has been pretty tough to me on many occasions but God has been extremely generous. He gave me the opportunity of fulfilling a dream as big as being president of the republic, which is being president of the most gutsy club in Ecuador," Bucaram said after being sworn in as club president.

"I learned to say 'Barcelona' about the same time I learned to scream 'mama'. ... I'm sure there is no Ecuadorean who does not dream of one day becoming a great soccer player for Barcelona or becoming president of Barcelona Sporting Club," he said, local media reported on Tuesday.

Bucaram was elected president of the club in a single ballot vote on Monday. But he swiftly came under fire from critics who said he should focus on battling national problems such as steep unemployment and poverty, which have sparked violent protests.

Bucaram has dazzled Ecuador since taking office last year by recording a music CD called "Madman in Love," singing at concerts, flying combat planes, dining with Lorena Bobbit, shaving his moustache for charity and playing soccer matches.
Barcelona, one of the country's most popular and wealthiest soccer teams, failed to make the first division league finals in 1996 or qualify for the South American Libertadores Cup.
